newsitem.title: USA: Vencor completes Transitional tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Vencor completes Transitional tender offer.

text.p: Vencor Inc., a health care services provider, said Friday it has completed a cash tender offer of $16 a share for 37,247,234, or about 95.5 percent, of Transitional Hospitals Corp.'s outstanding shares.
The company said it will acquire the remaining shares of Las Vegas-based Transitional for $16 a share in cash.
Vencor succeeded in its $624 million takeover after it topped a rival bid of $14.55 a share by Select Medical Corp. in May.
Vencor, based in Louisville, Ky., said the combined company will have annual revenues of about $3.3 billion.
Vencor's stock rose 25 cents to $44.125, while Transitional edged down 12.5 cents to $15.875 on the New York Stock Exchange in late morning trading.
